subject: Tenant data retirement request — prompts/outputs/logs
messages:
From: Olivia Chang <olivia.chang@bluewave.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: data-protection@bluewave.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tenant data retirement for account BW-8811 (prompts, outputs, logs)

Hi Karthik,

BlueWave is initiating a tenant offboarding per our contract termination (attached). We need Redwood to permanently remove all tenant-identified artifacts tied to account BW-8811: prompt inputs, model outputs, KV/prefix cache snapshots, and the serving request logs (7/2025 — present).

Ask: please confirm Redwood's operational workflow, a proposed mutual action plan (MAP), and estimated time-to-completion. We will need a signed redaction certificate and an evidence package showing deletion of traces and log manifests.

Constraints and notes:
- Do not delete archived billing records (finance needs those).
- Retain audit metadata (job ids, timestamps) for 180 days but remove any content payloads.
- We prefer a completion window within 10 business days if possible.

Attachment: bluewave-termination.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Olivia Chang
Head of Data Governance
BlueWave Analytics
olivia.chang@bluewave.com

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Chang <olivia.chang@bluewave.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tenant data retirement for account BW-8811 (prompts, outputs, logs)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. I’ve looped in Marissa (Customer Ops) and Vanessa (SRE/Runbook owner) to scope the operational plan.

Proposed next steps (draft MAP):
1) Intake verification (today): confirm list of artifact types and any exclusions.
2) Ticket creation in RED-4521 and UCS job scheduling (Ops).
3) Pre-run snapshot and manifest export (read-only) for BlueWave to verify, within 48 hours of scheduling.
4) Purge execution: object-level and KV clearing + request-log content redaction.
5) Evidence package + signed redaction certificate delivered to BlueWave and recorded in the ticket.

Can you confirm the exclusions (billing) and that the 180-day audit metadata retention is acceptable? If yes, Marissa and Vanessa will propose a nominal execution date.

I attached a quick MAP draft for your review.

Attachment: MAP-draft-BlueWave.docx (DOCX)

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: tenant data retirement for account BW-8811 (prompts, outputs, logs)

Karthik / Vanessa —

I reviewed the MAP draft and the requested scope. Ops notes / runbook highlights:
- Prechecks: confirm account selectors, retention-exempt buckets, and current active rolling caches.
- Isolation: schedule a maintenance window for the purges (we can do non-peak UTC 02:00–05:00).
- Execution phases: prefix/KV cache purge -> object store content expunge (with tombstone) -> redact request-level log payloads (leave headers/ids).
- Verification: generate a cryptographic manifest that lists removed object ids and a checksum for the evidence bundle.
- Rollback: none — this is permanent; we will snapshot manifests only for verification before deletion.

I propose the run on Wed 2027-04-07 02:30 UTC, which satisfies the 10-business-day ask. Vanessa, can you sanity-check resource availability? Neha, please prepare the evidence template and redaction certificate stub.

Attachment: purge-runbook-v1.md (MD)

-Marissa
Senior Customer Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Chang <olivia.chang@bluewave.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: data-protection@bluewave.com
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tenant data retirement for account BW-8811 (prompts, outputs, logs)

Karthik / Marissa — thanks.

Confirmed: 180-day metadata-only retention is acceptable. Wed 2027-04-07 at 02:30 UTC works for BlueWave. Please ensure the pre-run manifest is shared at least 24 hours in advance for our legal team to validate. We will require the redaction certificate to include the job ids and the root-of-trust signature.

Also: please call out any downstream replica/backup stores in your runbook and confirm those will be scrubbed or out-of-scope (flag explicitly). If any backups are out-of-scope, we need a timeline for their sanitization.

Olivia

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Chang <olivia.chang@bluewave.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: tenant data retirement for account BW-8811 (prompts, outputs, logs)

Olivia — job executed and evidence delivered. Summary below, full manifest attached.

Execution summary (2027-04-07 02:30 UTC):
- Scope: account BW-8811 — prompt inputs, model outputs, KV/prefix caches, serving request payloads (7/2025–04/2027).
- Exclusions: archived billing records (finance confirmed) and system-level audit headers (metadata only retained, no payload).
- Replicas/Backups: all identified object replicas in primary and regional buckets were scrubbed. Long-term cold backups (tape/archival retention) flagged as pending — estimated scrub window 30 days; ticket RED-4521 updated with schedule and owner.
- Evidence: attached erase_manifest_20270406.pdf containing removed object ids, timestamps, checksums, and runbook job ids. Redaction certificate signed by Redwood SRE lead (vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai).

Please reply to confirm receipt. We will close RED-4521 once BlueWave confirms the manifest.

Attachment: erase_manifest_20270406.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
